title: Olayinka & Adebobola — Wedding Website
description: An elegant, fully responsive wedding website for a December 2026 celebration at the Grand Ballroom, Ibadan. Opens with a cinematic video montage and falling-petal animation, then reveals a countdown timer, story timeline, event details, gallery, and a music player. title: Talyn: AI Learning Engagement Platform
description: AI-powered learning engagement platform built end to end across three services: a FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend, a React + TypeScript frontend, and a Claude-powered AI coach. The backend exposes 15 API route modules with JWT access/refresh rotation, RBAC for learner/creator/admin roles, an immutable audit log, and Google ID-token sign-in. The coaching service has 17 endpoints grounded in a live LearnerContext (XP, streaks, quiz history, badges, missions, course progress) and is covered by 76 offline contract tests against a fake LLM client. Payments use Paystack with HMAC-SHA512 signed webhooks and a single idempotent settlement path. Delivered with Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, pytest/Vitest, and an operations runbook for backups and secret rotation.

title: My-TaxPal: AI Tax Compliance & Advisory Assistant
description: RAG-powered chatbot that demystifies Nigeria's 2025 Tax Reform Bills. Indexes official legislative documents in ChromaDB and wires LangChain retrievers so every answer is grounded in verifiable source excerpts, eliminating hallucinations on high-stakes compliance questions. A LangGraph conversation flow preserves context across multi-turn advisory sessions and explains complex scenarios in plain English.

title: AI Study Architect — Multi-Agent PDF Intelligence
description: Full-stack AI learning platform that turns static PDFs into an interactive study workspace. A LangGraph workflow coordinates Librarian, Scholar, Note-Taker, Examiner, and Tutor agents, with a Critic step that verifies summaries and notes before they reach the learner. A persistent ChromaDB vector store grounds the chat tutor in the uploaded document, while the Examiner generates structured multiple-choice quizzes with explanations. FastAPI streams agent progress to the React client over Server-Sent Events, and Supabase/PostgreSQL persists sessions and chat history across devices.

title: SoulSync — Hybrid Psychotherapy Wellness Agent
description: Hybrid AI wellness system pairing local NLP emotion classification (DistilRoBERTa) with generative empathy (Gemini and OpenAI) to deliver secure, context-aware, CBT-informed interventions. Emotion classification feeds the LLM prompt context so responses stay grounded in structured therapeutic logic rather than open-ended generation. Designed a Supabase schema with Row-Level Security for full user-data isolation and restructured a monolithic script into a containerized, microservice-ready FastAPI/React/PostgreSQL architecture.
